comment: Canonical action-result shapes for the delivery contract. Every case fixes the four stable top-level fields; backends add their own strategy, message, and detail keys around them. A refusal always carries alsoRefused, empty when the ladder walked past nothing else, so a caller never has to distinguish a missing field from an empty one.
